description:
Plumb bug-report candidates into the outbound pipeline from the two natural sources: (1) scenario-qa team handoffs that identify real project-level bugs during affected-scenario checks, and (2) prompt-manager agent handoff docs that note bugs/gaps in tooling.

Agents emit a structured signal ('candidate bug report' + evidence). The pipeline consumes it, not the other way around — agents don't know or care about submission mechanics.
name: agent-bug-report-emission
title: Emit structured bug-report signals from agent handoffs
